params.initialPriceMaxAge: Seconds. **0 disables the staleness check** — correct on a pinned        anvil fork, wrong on mainnet. See `ChainlinkPriceLib.readPrice`.
params.initialTargets: Seed allowlist — the venues and tokens the agent may reach.
params.initialValuations: Seed price feeds for non-base tokens the agent may hold.
params.owner_: Platform operator. May edit the defaults; has no power over any live vault.

createVault((address,string,string,addre.details: The clone's allowlist and valuation set are copied from the factory defaults **at this      moment**. Later changes to the defaults do not reach vaults already created.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setDefaultValuation(address,address).details: Passing `feed == address(0)` removes the token from the default valuation set.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.
